name: Spreadsheet & data clean-up freelancing (category)
summary: Freelance work tidying, entering and organizing business data in spreadsheets: removing duplicates, fixing formats, building simple formulas and reports.
whatYouDo: You take messy customer lists, inventory sheets or exported records and clean them: removing duplicates, standardizing names and dates, splitting or merging columns, and entering missing data from source documents. More skilled freelancers add formulas, pivot tables and simple dashboards.
appeal: Quiet, independent, text-only work with no calls
You can start small with fixed-price projects
Spreadsheet skills pay more than plain data entry: Upwork's median is about $20/hr for Excel experts versus $13/hr for data entry (currency not stated)
Job Bank lists a national median of about $23.50/hr for employed data entry clerks
watchOuts: Job Bank rates Ontario's 2025–2027 outlook for data entry clerks as Limited because employment is declining
Job Bank notes AI tools such as OCR and robotic process automation are automating data entry tasks
Global freelance competition keeps plain data-entry rates low (Upwork typical $10–$20/hr; currency not stated)
Remote data-entry employee jobs are rare: a remote search for Canada on Indeed (2026-10-13) returned mostly on-site postings
'Data entry clerk' is a classic scam title: fake employers send cheques to deposit and forward, or recruit you as a 'payment processor'. Never move money for an employer

training.notes: No training route was checked. Learning lookups, pivot tables and clean-up functions is what separates this from low-paid typing work.

compensation.notes: Upwork's own rate pages (search summary): data entry specialists median $13/hr (typically $10–$20); Excel experts median $20/hr (typically $12–$30). Currency not stated. For comparison, Job Bank shows employed data entry clerks (NOC 14111) at a national median of about $23.50/hr CAD (low $17.00, high $32.60; 2023–2024 LFS).

reliability.notes: Freelance clean-up work is project-based. Employee data-entry demand is shrinking in Ontario, according to Job Bank.

fees: Freelance marketplaces such as Upwork charge service fees (see those platforms' own records).
applicationSteps: Build skills beyond typing: clean-up functions, lookups, pivot tables and basic charts
Make two or three before-and-after sample sheets using made-up data
Offer fixed-price clean-up jobs to local businesses or on established freelance marketplaces
Never accept a 'data entry' job that sends you a cheque or asks you to move money
fitsIf: You enjoy careful, quiet detail work and are willing to learn spreadsheet skills beyond basic typing.
notFitIf: You are looking for an easy work-from-home typing job with steady hours.
